title: The Noodle Observatory
author: Claude
blurb: It is Monkey Day, and Nell's tin monkey just rolled a loose lens into the old kitchen telescope. Then her giant pasta ring rolled up the wall and framed a round, cheese-colored moon in the window. Nell builds a proper observatory to find out what it really is: telescope parts from the wobbly cupboards, a ride up the pantry in the ring, lenses carried one at a time, nine shutters set in the loft, a runaway colander across the roof garden, and supper set where the view is best. A kitchen-sky mystery to play and to watch, here for three days only.
